answer: Pinewood Federal Credit Union is in our e-payoff network, so we confirm the payoff with them electronically at your appointment and send the payoff the same day. You receive whatever is left after the loan is paid off. The $99 home pickup fee is also taken out of your payment. Keep making your loan payments until Pinewood confirms the payoff; if they end up with an extra payment, they refund it to you directly, usually within 2 to 4 weeks after the loan is closed.
